content: Nvidia’s board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following a report from the New York Times about a second alleged extramarital affair, just days after he admitted to a separate affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, The Wall Street Journal reports. The second alleged affair was with an executive who reports to him, Nvidia’s vice president of health care, Kimberly Powell, according to the Times. The Nvidia board will meet as soon as today to decide on Huang’s future at the company, according to the Journal. Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment from The Verge. Huang and Powell, who are both married to other people, were allegedly captured together at a hotel in San Jose during Nvidia’s GTC developer conference in March, two unnamed sources told the Times. The Times has not seen the video. Rumors about a potential affair between the two had long circulated at Nvidia, an unnamed source told CNBC, partially because Powell does not have a health or science background. Nvidia’s stock fell more than 7 percent in after-hours trading Wednesday. Since Nvidia and Huang confirmed an extramarital relationship with Megaspeed executive and alleged spy Alice Huang and a subsequent investigation over the weekend, the company has said it retained former US attorney Joon H. Kim and his firm, Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz, to handle it, but today’s rumor suggests it won’t wait for those results to act. Last year, Huang hired crisis communications firm Heller known for handling public sex scandals, according to Wired. Its founder has advised several powerful men who faced public scrutiny, Wired reported, like former congressman Anthony Weiner and writer Jeffrey Toobin. Heller did not immediately respond to a request for comment from The Verge.

chineseContent: 据《华尔街日报》报道，在《纽约时报》报道了黄仁勋第二次涉嫌婚外情的报道后，英伟达董事会正准备解雇首席执行官黄仁勋，而就在几天前，黄仁勋承认与一名据称是中国间谍的女性有另一段婚外情。据《泰晤士报》报道，第二起涉嫌外遇的对象是一位向他汇报的高管，即英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell)。据《华尔街日报》报道，英伟达董事会将于今天召开会议，决定黄仁勋在公司的未来。英伟达没有立即回应 The Verge 的置评请求。两名不愿透露姓名的消息人士告诉《泰晤士报》，黄和鲍威尔均已与其他人结婚，据称他们在 3 月份的 Nvidia GTC 开发者大会期间在圣何塞的一家酒店一起被捕。 《泰晤士报》尚未看到该视频。一位不愿透露姓名的消息人士告诉 CNBC，有关两人之间潜在恋情的谣言在 Nvidia 流传已久，部分原因是鲍威尔没有健康或科学背景。周三盘后交易中，英伟达股价下跌逾 7%。自从 Nvidia 和 Huang 证实与 Megaspeed 高管和涉嫌间谍 Alice Huang 存在婚外关系，并在周末进行后续调查后，该公司表示已聘请前美国律师 Joon H. Kim 及其公司 Wachtell、Lipton、Rosen & Katz 来处理此事，但今天的传言表明，该公司不会等待调查结果采取行动。据《连线》报道，去年，黄聘请了以处理公共性丑闻而闻名的危机沟通公司 Heller。据《连线》报道，该公司的创始人曾为几位面临公众监督的有权势人士提供建议，例如前国会议员安东尼·韦纳和作家杰弗里·图宾。海勒没有立即回应 The Verge 的置评请求。
